harness.db: per-run disposable seeded SQLite (tests/setup/global-db.ts + tests/setup/db.ts); never dev.db
harness.notes: Seed has NO Enrollment rows and NO 'p-001'/'cat-*' ids (employees+catalog items use cuid). The authored cert-parsing.test.ts hard-codes profileId='p-001' and catalogItemId='cat-aws-saa'|'cat-kubernetes'|'cat-docker' — the cert-parsing test setup MUST create those exact ids (employee.create({id:'p-001'}), catalogItem.create({id:'cat-aws-saa'|...}) and an in-progress Enrollment for each) so confirmAndWriteSkill's FK lookups succeed and AC-03 'stays in-progress' is observable (plan §2.4 / F-04). The promotion scenario (S2-P3-04) instead targets the SEEDED 'synthetic-handle-001' cuid (the only deterministic TypeScript baseline) — documented divergence.
harness.spy_serialization: makeClaudeClientSpy(scriptedResponse) -> {content:[{type:'text', text: JSON.stringify(scriptedResponse)}]}; callClaude JSON.parses then schema.safeParse(raw) DIRECTLY (no normalization). So GIVEN payloads below are the EXACT shapes safeParse receives — AC-01 a FLAT single-skill object (top-level confidence), AC-02 a TOP-LEVEL ARRAY (per-skill confidence). CertParseResult is a z.preprocess normalizer that accepts both + an envelope (TADR-S2-01 v2).

scenarios.when: tests/cert-parsing.test.ts loads the module
scenarios.then: the suite fails on the missing import (not a misleading assertion)

phases.name: SUB-TASK-1 — parse core + prompt + schema + confidence gate + content-hash idempotency

scenarios.title: Cert parse happy path routes through Claude exactly once and Zod-validates
scenarios.given: an injected Claude client scripted (makeClaudeClientSpy) to return the FLAT single-skill object the authored AC-01 test uses verbatim — { skill:'AWS Certified Solutions Architect', issuer:'Amazon Web Services', date:'2026-05-01', level:'associate', confidence:0.96 } (cert-parsing.test.ts:30-36; top-level confidence; NO skills array) — and fixtures/certs/aws-saa-valid.pdf
scenarios.when: parseCertificate({ file: CERT_FIXTURES.validAwsSaa, claude }) is called
scenarios.then: claude.createMessage is called exactly once (BR-09 boundary); the CertParseResult z.preprocess normalizer wraps the flat object into skills[]; parsed.ok === true; parsed.skills[0].skill === 'AWS Certified Solutions Architect' (matches the authored assertion parsed.skills[0])
scenarios.test_function: AC-01 parseCertificate routes through Claude, Zod-validates

scenarios.title: Multi-skill cert returns ALL skills; null/missing optional date+level tolerated
scenarios.given: an injected client scripted (makeClaudeClientSpy) to return the TOP-LEVEL ARRAY the authored AC-02 test uses verbatim — [ {skill:'Kubernetes', issuer:'CNCF', date:'2026-04-10', level:'intermediate', confidence:0.9}, {skill:'Docker', issuer:'CNCF', date:null, level:null, confidence:0.88} ] (cert-parsing.test.ts:57-60; a bare array, NO top-level confidence; second entry date:null+level:null) — and fixtures/certs/multi-skill-bootcamp.pdf
scenarios.when: parseCertificate({ file: CERT_FIXTURES.multiSkill, claude }) is called
scenarios.then: claude.createMessage called once; the CertParseResult z.preprocess normalizer turns the top-level array into {skills:[...], confidence:min(0.9,0.88)=0.88}; parsed.ok === true; skills.length >= 2; the null-date/null-level entry validates (.nullish() level/date) — proving ambiguous optional fields do not break the parse
scenarios.test_function: AC-02 multi-skill parse returns all skills, optional fields tolerated

scenarios.title: Garbled JSON / invalid parse -> failure with exact message, no write
scenarios.given: makeClaudeClientGarbled() (invalid JSON) and fixtures/certs/not-a-cert.png
scenarios.when: parseCertificate({ file: CERT_FIXTURES.unreadable, claude }) is called
scenarios.then: parsed.ok === false, parsed.userMessage contains "We couldn't reliably read this certificate", and NO Certificate row and NO EmployeeSkill row are created
scenarios.test_function: AC-03 garbled parse -> failure message, nothing written

scenarios.title: Sub-threshold confidence is treated as failure (write nothing)
scenarios.given: an injected client returning schema-valid JSON with confidence below CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
scenarios.when: parseCertificate is called
scenarios.then: parsed.ok === false with the spec'd userMessage, and nothing is persisted (the confidence gate fires even though JSON validated)

scenarios.title: Idempotent double-submit: one Certificate, prior uploadId, no re-parse
scenarios.given: the same certificate bytes (same contentHash) submitted twice for the same employee
scenarios.when: the upload path processes the redundant submission
scenarios.then: exactly one Certificate row exists for (employeeId, contentHash), the second call returns the prior uploadId (deduped), and the Claude boundary is NOT invoked a second time

scenarios.title: Multi-skill cert with a sub-threshold per-skill confidence is treated as failure (BR-02, multi-skill gate)
scenarios.given: an injected client scripted to return a TOP-LEVEL ARRAY of two skills where one carries a confidence below CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (e.g. [{skill:'Kubernetes', confidence:0.9}, {skill:'Docker', confidence:0.2}])
scenarios.when: parseCertificate is called (confidenceThreshold=CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD)
scenarios.then: the normalizer derives top-level confidence=min(0.9,0.2)=0.2, the callClaude confidence gate fires, parsed.ok === false with the spec'd userMessage, and NOTHING is persisted — proving BR-02 low-confidence semantics are defined for the multi-skill array case (F-02)
scenarios.test_function: AC-03 multi-skill sub-threshold confidence -> failure, nothing written

phases.name: SUB-TASK-2 — confirmCertExtraction: upsert+promote to verified, de-dupe fallback, item -> done

scenarios.title: Confirm writes one VERIFIED skill (source=CERTIFICATE, origin=ACQUIRED); item -> done
scenarios.given: a parsed extraction and a profile with an in-progress Enrollment for the catalog item
scenarios.when: confirmAndWriteSkill({ profileId, catalogItemId, skill }) is called on confirm
scenarios.then: exactly one EmployeeSkill row exists with trustState=VERIFIED, source=CERTIFICATE, origin=ACQUIRED; the returned object matches { source:'certificate', state:'verified', verified:true }; and the Enrollment status becomes COMPLETED (itemStatus 'done')
scenarios.test_function: AC-01 confirm -> verified write + item done

scenarios.title: Each multi-skill entry written verified, including the null-date/level one
scenarios.given: a multi-skill extraction (one entry has null date and null level)
scenarios.when: confirmAndWriteSkill is called for each extracted skill
scenarios.then: every confirmed skill is written verified (source=certificate, state=verified, verified=true) — the null-date/null-level entry writes successfully, proving ambiguous optional fields do not break the write
scenarios.test_function: AC-02 confirm each multi-skill entry verified

scenarios.title: Promotion in place on the same canonical record; no duplicate row
scenarios.given: employee synthetic-handle-001 already holds TypeScript as a self-reported baseline EmployeeSkill (seed line ~156)
scenarios.when: a TypeScript certificate is confirmed and written via confirmAndWriteSkill
scenarios.then: the SAME EmployeeSkill row is promoted in place to VERIFIED (same row id; createdNewRow=false), and the count of EmployeeSkill rows for (employee, TypeScript canonical skill) remains exactly 1 (no duplicate)
scenarios.test_function: AC-22 single canonical record promoted in place

scenarios.title: Re-assert at equal-or-lower trust is a no-op; never demotes
scenarios.given: a skill already at VERIFIED
scenarios.when: the same skill is re-confirmed (verified again) or a lower-trust write is attempted
scenarios.then: upsertAndPromoteSkill no-ops (state stays VERIFIED, createdNewRow=false), no duplicate row, no demotion

scenarios.title: De-dupe advisor failure (TS-002) does not block the verified write
scenarios.given: an unknown skill name and a Layer-2 skill-identity client that throws/returns invalid JSON (makeClaudeClientThatThrows / Garbled)
scenarios.when: confirmAndWriteSkill resolves the canonical skill and writes
scenarios.then: the confirm path does NOT throw/hang, the skill is written VERIFIED via a create-new canonical record keyed by the deterministic canonicalKey, and the key is flagged reconcilePending (isReconcilePending true) — degraded de-dupe, never a broken write
scenarios.test_function: TS-002 de-dupe advisor failure falls back, write completes

scenarios.title: Idempotent re-confirm of an already-promoted upload
scenarios.given: a confirmCertExtraction(uploadId, skills) call that already promoted the skills
scenarios.when: the same uploadId is confirmed again (double-click / retry)
scenarios.then: the action returns the existing promoted skills with no second promotion and no duplicate EmployeeSkill row
